relation.note: The subject composed a poem in praise of him.

event.desc: composed a poem (qaṣīda) in praise of Fatḥ al-Dīn al-Muḥarraqī, beginning: 'Ya ṣadr ḥubbuka sāʾir fī sāʾirī / Ḥattā khayāluka fī manāmī zāʾirī'

person.note: アハマド・アル＝クラシー：私は彼を知らなかったが、彼がファトフ・アル＝ディーン・アル＝ムハッラキーを称賛する詩を詠んだのを見た。その冒頭は次の通りである：「おお胸よ、あなたの愛は私の中に遍く巡り／あなたの幻さえも夢の中に私を訪れる」。

Aḥmad al-Qurashī: I did not know him, but I saw a poem by him in which he praised Fatḥ al-Dīn al-Muḥarraqī, the beginning of which is: 'O heart, your love is circulating throughout me / Until your phantom visits me in my dream.'
